sloka: लक्ष्मण अनुगत श्रीमान् वीक्ष्यमाणो वसुन्धराम् ।एवम् संभाषमाणौ तौ अन्योन्यम् भ्रातरौ उभौ ॥३-६४-२४॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇa anugata śrīmān vīkṣyamāṇo vasundharām ।evam saṁbhāṣamāṇau tau anyonyam bhrātarau ubhau ॥3-64-24॥

translations.english: Talking with each other, the two brothers took the path on earth strewn with flowers.
